assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope.
The syncope episodes are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring.
The symptoms are intermittent and need correlation with underlying arrhythmias.
The etiology of the collapse must be determined.
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated.
The cardiac event monitoring study is for extended rhythm assessment.
The clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service.
